Not set. Without a key, describe image only reads text, and describe screen needs on-device AI

Get a free API key from Google AI Studio, at aistudio.google.com/apikey, and paste it here. To remove your key, clear the field and save.\n\nImages and screens that you describe are sent to Google. On the free tier, Google can use them to improve its products.
